I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread to say so, and I'm treating the date as unverified.

To check it, I looked through #central-team and the public files Pree could see herself. There are no Brackenwater contract, CRM or profile files on the share, and nothing in the channel mentions the account.

In the thread, I suggested that whoever owns the account check the date against the signed contract or CRM record, or get the customer to confirm it in writing, before anyone plans around it. Nothing needed approval.
